name: Tilray Brands, Inc.
hq: New York, New York, USA (major operations in Leamington, Ontario)
ceo: Irwin D. Simon (Chairman and CEO since the 2021 Aphria-Tilray combination)
segment: Canadian LP / global cannabis and consumer goods company
headline_status: Tilray is a diversified cannabis, craft-beer, distribution and wellness company whose beverage business, expanded by the 2026 BrewDog purchase, now outsells its cannabis segment.
summary: Tilray Brands began as a Canadian licensed cannabis producer and has grown into a broader consumer-goods group. It grows medical and adult-use cannabis across more than 6 million square feet of capacity in Canada, Portugal and Germany, runs a pharmaceutical distribution business in Europe, sells hemp foods and wellness products, and is one of the largest U.S. craft brewers. In March 2026 it bought key BrewDog assets in the U.K. and Ireland for £33 million, and from January 2027 it will brew and sell Carlsberg brands in the U.S. In the quarter ended August 31, 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), revenue rose 23% to a record $257.1 million: beverage was $101.5 million, distribution $84.3 million and cannabis $56.1 million, with cannabis down year over year as international medical sales grew and Canadian sales eased. It posted a $40.0 million net loss, mainly from non-cash charges, and $9.2 million of adjusted EBITDA, and reaffirmed fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $68-75 million. Tilray did a 1-for-10 reverse split in December 2025.

faq.q: Is Tilray still a cannabis company?
faq.a: Yes, but cannabis is no longer its largest segment. In the August 2026 quarter, cannabis was $56.1 million of $257.1 million in revenue, behind beverage ($101.5 million) and pharmaceutical distribution ($84.3 million).
Tilray bought key BrewDog assets in the U.K. and Ireland for £33 million in March 2026, and the brand is now part of its beverage segment.

faq.q: Does Tilray sell THC cannabis in the United States?
faq.a: No. Its U.S. business is beer, spirits and hemp-based products. Its cannabis is grown in Canada, Portugal and Germany and sold in Canada and international medical markets.
TLRY on both the Nasdaq and the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Tilray's fiscal year ends May 31, so the quarter ended August 31, 2026 is the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
